name: Troll Fury — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Troll Fury from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Troll Fury (CR 8)", "Troll Fury" but are not part of the Troll Fury entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Troll Fury (CR 8)

TROLL FURY
CR 8

The troll fury is an experienced steward of nature, watching over nearby troll individuals and tribes to make sure they don’t consume too much game.

XP 4,800
Troll druid (troll fury) 6
CE Large humanoid (giant)
